about: The minisign public keys that sign urMQTT releases, each for a range of tags only (docs/RELEASE.md section 9, docs/release-key-rotation.md). Paths are relative to this file. Read by the builder page (tools/builder/web/bundle.mjs), the release mirror (scripts/mirror-releases.py --keyring) and scripts/check-release-key.sh.

keys.name: release
keys.note: The project's release key (id 721316B961DCB94B, generated 2026-11-06 on the maintainer's machine, passwordless because the CI signs with it; the secret is kept outside every repository and in the repository secret MINISIGN_SECRET_KEY). Signs every release after v0.4.1.

keys.name: test
keys.note: The project's former TEST key. It signed v0.1.0 to v0.4.1 (those signatures stay valid) and is considered compromised from the day the release key exists: it is accepted for those tags only, never for a newer one, and for each of them only the SHA256SUMS whose SHA-256 is pinned below (the published file, fetched from GitHub and checked against this key on 2026-11-06).
